name: Patty's Cleaning Services
email_sources: Square Online business data embedded in https://tidybypatty.square.site/ (fetched via curl, found in page JSON as info@pattyscleaningservices.com)
Nextdoor business page https://nextdoor.com/pages/pattys-cleaning-services-pembroke-pines-fl-2/ (same address, same phone 954-432-8888, confirms it is the same business)
own_site_check_result: pattyscleaningservices.com DOES resolve in DNS (208.91.197.27, a domain-parking range) but serves no real site: HTTPS returns a self-signed certificate with no matching content and HTTP returns 503 Service Unavailable. The business likely registered this domain years ago only to use it for email, and never built or launched a website on it. pattyscleaningservice.com (no 's' before 'service') resolves and loads, but it is a DIFFERENT, unrelated business: 'Patty's Cleaning Service' in Concord, CA (East Bay Area), phone (925) 682-7005, est. 1997, confirmed by WHOIS-independent content fetch. The business's own Google Business Profile 'Website' button points only to the Square booking page (https://book.squareup.com/appointments/pheb3rasgl5rwi/location/D1DVGFJD6NCK4/services), confirmed live via a headless-browser visit to the Google Maps listing. Conclusion: no live, own website; confirmed per task brief.
rating_source: Live Google Maps listing, fetched via headless browser (Playwright) on the exact address, matching the task brief exactly (4.6 stars, 361 reviews, phone +1 954-432-8888, website field = Square booking link).

hours.source: Live Google Maps listing, fetched via headless browser on the exact business address.

social_notes: The Weston/Miramar-Pembroke Pines Chamber of Commerce directory listing for this business references Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn 'Connect With Us' icons, but the chamber's listing detail page (ID 10476) now redirects to a generic category page and the live icon URLs could not be recovered. No working Instagram or Facebook profile URL could be confirmed after search engine queries, Nextdoor, Yelp (blocked, 403) and Thumbtack. Recorded as null rather than guessed.

reputation_note: IMPORTANT CONTEXT FOR THE TEAM (not used anywhere on the site): Google (4.6/361) and Thumbtack (4.9/89, reviews sourced from Google) both show a strongly positive, high-volume reputation, and the 4 review quotes used above are real, verbatim, recent (2025) Google reviews. Separately, web search surfaced a very different Yelp listing for the same address (1.2-1.5 stars across various snapshots, with photo captions and a BBB review alleging serious misconduct by the owner, including racial-slur and false-police-report allegations). This Yelp/BBB material was not verified further, was not used anywhere in the build, and none of its photos were downloaded or considered (consistent with the gallery curation rules regardless). Flagging it here only so Merktop can factor it into the outreach decision; it does not appear in data used for the site itself.

photos.source: Live Google Business Profile photo gallery (lh3.googleusercontent.com), extracted via a headless-browser (Playwright) visit to the exact Google Maps listing, downloaded via curl with a Chrome user agent, verified as real JPEGs with PIL, resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82.

template_base: templates/light/index.html (Amani light example), recolored from the warm-mocha token palette to a custom light orchid/plum palette derived from the business's real brand colors (purple/lavender/pink seen in its Google/Nextdoor logo and marketing graphic), keeping the exact same token names, structure, CSS and motion system.
build_variant: Standard variant with a real booking integration: this business DOES have an active booking system (Square), unlike a typical 'no-booking' adapted-variant business, so all primary CTAs point to the real Square booking link instead of phone-only. No itemized pricing is published, so service cards use 'Book now' / 'Get a quote' CTAs instead of prices (per the adapted-variant guidance for pricing). A real street address was confirmed, so the location section includes a live Google Maps iframe embed (unlike businesses without a public address).
notes: Deep email search succeeded: info@pattyscleaningservices.com was found independently on the business's Square Online site data and its Nextdoor business page, both anchored to the same phone number and address, so it was used as the primary outreach channel instead of falling back to pending_manual. See 'reputation_note' above for an important, unverified reputational flag (Yelp/BBB) that was not used anywhere in the build but is worth the team's awareness before outreach.
